subject: Ignite Labs cohort: promo credits & pooling options
messages:
From: Ariel Stern <ariel@ignite-labs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Promo credits for Ignite cohort — ask and timeline

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for taking this — we're gearing up for our summer cohort (approx. 40 early-stage teams) and need clarity on two things before we go to procurement: 1) whether Redwood can offer a pooled promo-credit model that the accelerator can manage centrally, and 2) if there are one-time onboarding credits for pilot/proof-of-concepts.

High-level context: most teams will be using embeddings + generation for chat/tuning; we estimate median consumption of ~25k tokens/month per team in month 1 increasing to ~75k by month 3 for active builders. Budget is tight — we need a mix of free credits for demo day plus a path to a discounted paid conversion for Dedicated capacity for a small subset.

Can you confirm:
- If credits can be pooled and reallocated across startups (yes/no + limits)
- Typical promo sizes you offer for cohorts (example sizes)
- Whether credits are refundable/escrow-able if unused

Attaching our cohort one-pager (see attachment: ignite-cohort-deck.pdf) — Samir (procurement) will loop in on legal once we have numbers. Ideally we'd have a term sheet this week so procurement can get internal approval.

Thanks,
Ariel Stern
Director, Programs — Ignite Labs
A: ariel@ignite-labs.com

Attachment: ignite-cohort-deck.pdf (presentation, 6 slides)

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ariel Stern <ariel@ignite-labs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credits for Ignite cohort — ask and timeline

Hi Ariel — great to hear from you and congrats on the cohort. Looping Ben (our accelerator programs lead) and Laura (solutions/ops) so we can land practical options quickly.

High-level options that have worked for similar partners (two starter options):

1) Cohort Starter Pack (fast onboarding)
- 50k free tokens per startup (poolable up to groups of 10)
- Optional 3-month Dedicated trial for up to 5 teams (20% off list for first 6 months)
- Onboarding credit: one-time 25k tokens to help demo day builds

2) Conversion-Ready Promo (deeper trial)
- 100k pooled tokens for the program (poolable across entire cohort)
- Escrowed tranche: 50% released at start, 50% released on milestone (demo day)
- Preferential conversion terms to Dedicated with a usage discount and a credits-to-invoice conversion rate

A couple quick asks to size this properly: can you share (estimate is fine) the % of teams you expect to convert to paid Dedicated in the first 6 months and any constraints on pooling/accounting for the cohort's finance team?

I've attached a one-page options summary (Ignite-cohort-options.pdf). If you're open, I'd propose a 30-minute call tomorrow to walk the options and get procurement questions.

Quick note on tax/billing: credits are typically applied as a prepayment/credit line; when converted to Dedicated we can provide an addendum that maps credits to invoice line items. We'll confirm exact accounting language with legal.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: Ignite-cohort-options.pdf (1 page)

From: Ariel Stern <ariel@ignite-labs.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@ignite-labs.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credits for Ignite cohort — ask and timeline

Thanks Evelyn — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our end:
- Pooling: we'd prefer a single pool the accelerator controls; can you confirm how transfers/reallocation work if a team closes funding and we want to move credits?
- Conversion: roughly 8–10 teams (20–25% of cohort) are likely to convert to Dedicated in 3–6 months if we give them a clear path and onboarding support.
- Budget: procurement asked whether we can get an additional one-time onboarding credit of 50k tokens (above the starter pack) for teams that win demo day grants.

Samir is on cc for procurement-specific language. If helpful, we can make procurement available for a short call tomorrow afternoon.

Cheers,
Ariel

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ariel Stern <ariel@ignite-labs.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T10:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Promo credits for Ignite cohort — ask and timeline

Hi Ariel — great context, thanks. A few operational commitments we can make (subject to SOW/addendum):

- Pooling mechanics: credits can be pooled under the accelerator umbrella and reallocated within the cohort via a central admin dashboard. We support manual transfers and API-driven reallocation; transfers between startups are allowed but we cap automatic transfers to groups of up to 10 startups without additional approval.

- Onboarding credit: we can approve the extra 50k one-time onboarding credit for demo-day winners, provided the cohort signs a short addendum that lays out conversion rules.

- Conversion accounting: credits applied to Dedicated are converted at a 0.85 rate (i.e., 1 credit = 0.85 invoice unit) to account for provisioning and setup; for cohorts committing to >= $25k/mo aggregate spend we can improve the conversion to 0.95.

I've drafted a quick pricing-comparison.xlsx (attached) that shows the Starter Pack vs Conversion-Ready Promo and sample P&L at various conversion rates.

Next steps (proposed):
- I'll upload an SOW draft and an addendum for the pooling rules.
- Laura, can you prepare the brief on billing/accounting language for procurement?

Appreciate the fast cadence — happy to jump on a call with Samir tomorrow.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: pricing-comparison.xlsx (spreadsheet)

- 2027-05-20: Ignite to review and provide procurement feedback / any redlines — Ariel/Samir

Key points for procurement: credits are poolable under the accelerator umbrella, transfers supported via dashboard or API, demo-day onboarding credits (50k per winner) approved pending addendum. Conversion rules and the conversion rate tiers will be captured in the pricing schedule.

I'll attach the SOW draft now and include a short billing appendix; Ben will follow up with the pricing workbook for your finance team. Please share any procurement contact details we should include in the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Laura Bennett
